requirements.description: Heldout split must contain unseen partner dynamics or policy-update rules, not only hidden labels or renamed partners.
At least one evaluation family must shift partner policy after interaction history so the candidate must update other_state from behavior.
Counterfactual tests must alter partner response structure while holding non-causal surfaces constant where possible.
Future task must intervene on candidate social-latent state or update path through freeze, deletion, shuffle, replacement, corruption, or controlled perturbation.
Future task must intervene on partner observation stream or history to test whether predicted behavior changes in the predeclared direction.
Every train, heldout, and counterfactual context must have IDs, but IDs must be audited so they cannot carry target or partner-type labels.
At least one deliberately injected leakage case must be detected by the leakage scanner and treated as a required scanner failure.
At least one no-signal case must show that the candidate and non-oracle baselines cannot legitimately exceed chance or declared prior performance.
